fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-11-25 at about 02:20, it was reported that a silver van bearing registration number TN-69-ZZ-1089 belonging to the complainant was taken from Vetri Colony Industrial Area in Erode. The complainant, Meena Krishnan, provided the contact number 9000000474. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Madhan Palanisamy (9000000295) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Van reportedly taken from an unattended lot.
fields.Keywords: van theft, vehicle, industrial area, van, CCTV, witness, night
